default: Highlight an option to see what it does.

rows.set_game_freelook: Yes: the mouse looks up and down. No: moving the mouse forward and back walks instead, unless you hold Mouse Look.
rows.set_game_autoreload: Reload automatically when the magazine runs empty.
rows.set_game_autoswitch: Switch to a new weapon automatically when you pick it up.
rows.set_game_togglezoom: Yes: press zoom once to zoom in and again to zoom out. No: hold zoom to stay zoomed in.
rows.set_game_scopesensitivity: Look speed while zoomed or scoped, as a percent of normal. With 360 Controller Feel the stick uses 360 Zoomed Speed instead.
rows.set_game_fov: How much of the world you see, measured at 4:3; wide screens add more at the sides. Higher sees more, lower looks closer.
rows.set_game_showdecals: Show bullet holes, scorch marks and blood on walls and floors.
rows.set_game_showgun: Show your weapon on screen. No hides it for a clearer view.
rows.set_game_gunXYZ: Where your weapon sits on screen: to the right, centered, or lower right.
rows.set_game_simpleitems: Multiplayer: how pickups look. The original models, simple icons, or flat colored icons with or without a light sweep.
rows.set_game_opponentweaponstyle: Multiplayer: draw the weapons other players hold in flat icon colors, so you can tell what they carry at a glance.
rows.set_game_forcemodel: Multiplayer: show every player with the bright pro skins, so opponents are easier to spot.
rows.set_game_mpitch: Flip vertical mouse look: moving the mouse forward looks down.
rows.set_game_msmooth: Blend this many mouse readings together. Higher is smoother but adds a little delay; 1 is off.
rows.set_game_msensitivity: How fast the view turns when you move the mouse.
rows.set_game_mcpi: Your mouse's counts per inch (CPI/DPI), so sensitivity follows real hand movement. 0 keeps the classic sensitivity.
rows.set_game_mfilter: Smooth the view by averaging this many recent view angles after the mouse moves. 0 is off.
rows.set_game_maccel: Mouse acceleration, Quake Live style: faster swipes turn farther. Negative values slow fast swipes instead. 0 is off.
rows.set_game_macceloffset: How fast the mouse must move before acceleration starts.
rows.set_game_maccelpower: Shape of the acceleration curve. 2 matches Quake Live; higher ramps up more sharply.
rows.set_game_msenscap: Upper limit for accelerated sensitivity. 0 means no limit.
rows.set_game_controller_enabled: Use a gamepad. No ignores all controllers.
rows.set_game_controller_xenon: The Xbox 360 version's stick feel (dead zones, look curve, smoothing, turn speeds). Overrides Stick Dead Zone, Look Sensitivity and Look Curve.
rows.set_game_controller_aimassist: Xbox 360 aim assist. Slowdown Only: stick turning slows over an enemy. Full: shots also bend to the enemy body part nearest your crosshair.
rows.set_game_controller_aimassist_friction: Turn speed while your aim is on an enemy, as a percent of normal. Lower feels stickier; 100 turns the slowdown off.
rows.set_game_controller_xenon_yaw: 360 Controller Feel: left and right turn speed. 0.0253 is the Xbox 360 default.
rows.set_game_controller_xenon_pitch: 360 Controller Feel: up and down look speed. 0.0209 is the Xbox 360 default.
rows.set_game_controller_xenon_zoom: 360 Controller Feel: turn speed while zoomed, as a percent of normal. 30 is the Xbox 360 default.
rows.set_game_controller_layout: Southpaw swaps the sticks: move with the right stick and look with the left.
rows.set_game_controller_prompts: Which button icons to show. Automatic matches the controller you are using.
rows.set_game_controller_deadzone: How far a stick must move before it counts. Raise it if the view drifts on its own.
rows.set_game_controller_look_sensitivity: How fast the view turns with the look stick.
rows.set_game_controller_wheel_sensitivity: How fast the stick moves the weapon wheel's selection.
rows.set_game_wheel_offset: Moves the weapon wheel left or right. 0 centers it; 27 is the original position.
rows.set_game_controller_look_curve: Shapes the look stick's response. Higher makes small movements slower for fine aim, with full speed at the edge.
rows.set_game_controller_invert: Flip vertical stick look: pushing up looks down.
rows.set_game_controller_trigger: How far a trigger must be pulled before it counts as pressed.
rows.set_game_controller_rumble: Controller vibration when you fire, take damage and more.
rows.set_game_controller_rumble_strength: Vibration strength. 1 is normal; up to 2 is stronger.
rows.set_game_controller_gyro: Aim by tilting a controller that has motion sensors, such as PlayStation and Switch Pro controllers.
rows.set_game_controller_gyro_sensitivity: How far the view turns when you tilt the controller.
rows.set_game_controller_touchpad_mode: What the controller's touchpad does: nothing, move the menu cursor, look around, or work only as a button.
rows.set_game_controller_touchpad_sensitivity: How fast touchpad movement moves the cursor or the view.
rows.set_game_controller_touchscreen: Use a touchscreen like a mouse in menus and loading screens.
rows.set_game_controller_low_battery_rumble: Below this battery percent, vibration is turned down to save power. 0 turns this off.
rows.set_game_controller_low_battery_rumble_c: The strongest vibration allowed while the battery is below the Low Battery Rumble level.
rows.set_game_customxhair: Weapon Default gives each weapon its own crosshair. Custom uses the crosshair you pick below for every weapon.
rows.set_game_hitmarker: Flash a marker on the crosshair when your shots hit.
rows.set_game_hudlayout: HUD style: Classic (the original), Remastered (kept inside the safe area), Minimal (the essentials), or Competitive (multiplayer).
rows.set_game_hudscale: Size of the HUD, separate from the menus.
rows.set_game_hudwidth: How far the HUD spreads on wide screens: within 16:9, within 21:9, or the full width.
rows.set_game_hudinset: Moves the HUD in from the screen edges, in percent of the screen, for TVs that crop the picture.
rows.set_game_objectivestoggle: Yes: the objectives button opens and closes your objectives. No: they show only while you hold it.
rows.set_game_hudopacity: How solid the Remastered HUD is. Lower lets more of the game show through.
rows.set_game_huddamagedir: Show which direction damage is coming from.
rows.set_game_hudpickups: Show a message when you pick something up.
rows.set_game_hudstrip: Briefly show your weapon list when you switch weapons.
rows.set_game_hudflash: Tone down flashes: limits hit indicators, dims full-screen white flashes and removes the death afterimage.
rows.set_game_corpsesink: Bodies sink into the floor before they disappear. Ragdoll keeps ragdoll physics while they sink; No Ragdoll turns it off.
rows.set_game_corpsetime: How long bodies stay before they disappear. Stock keeps the game's own timing.
rows.set_game_language: The language for text and speech.
rows.set_game_consoleaccess: The keys that open the console: Tilde alone, or Ctrl+Alt+Tilde so it can't open by accident.
rows.set_game_autoskipcinematics: Skip cutscenes automatically as soon as they start.
rows.set_game_cl_gunfov: Field of view for your weapon only. 0 follows the main Field of View.
rows.set_game_cl_gunfov_adjust: With a Weapon FOV set: Classic keeps the weapon looking the same on any screen shape; Direct uses the value as is.
rows.set_game_cl_gun_x: Moves your weapon left or right on screen.
rows.set_game_cl_gun_y: Moves your weapon forward or back.
rows.set_game_cl_gun_z: Moves your weapon up or down.
rows.set_game_weaponkick: Your weapon kicks back on screen when it fires. No holds it still.
rows.set_game_vr_enable: Play in virtual reality with a connected headset.
rows.set_game_vr_aimmode: Aim where your weapon-hand controller points, or where you look.
rows.set_game_vr_lefthanded: Which hand holds the weapon. Left also moves you with the right stick.
rows.set_game_vr_turnmode: Turn in fixed steps (Snap) or smoothly with the stick.
rows.set_game_vr_snapturnangle: How many degrees each snap turn rotates you.
rows.set_game_vr_movedirection: Which way the stick walks you: where your head faces, or where your off-hand controller points.
rows.set_game_vr_roomscale: Your character follows you as you walk around your room. Disabled keeps it in place.
rows.set_game_vr_aimlaser: Show where your shots land while aiming with the controller: a dot, or a dot and a laser beam.
rows.set_game_vr_twohanded: Grip the front of the gun with your off hand to hold it in both hands.
rows.set_game_vr_vignette: Darkens the edges of your view while you move or turn smoothly, to reduce motion sickness.
rows.set_game_vr_physicalcrouch: Crouch in your room to crouch in the game.
